title: After 46 years, Oklahoma food bank serves its billionth meal; Thunder adds $25,000 donation
summary_full: On November 10, the Regional Food Bank of Oklahoma marked a historic milestone by packaging its one billionth meal, a testament to 46 years of tireless support from community partners and volunteers. The Oklahoma City Thunder made a significant donation to amplify hunger relief efforts. However, food insecurity still poses a critical challenge in Oklahoma, particularly affecting children.
